notes.title: Beyond the Long Night update - and 33% discount in the Steam Summer Sale!
notes.content:
Hello Explorers,

We are excited to announce that Beyond the Long Night is 33% off for the Staeam Summer Sale! If that news was not exciting enough we have also been hard at work with a new update. 

The update includes the new glasses upgrade category, some new upgrades,  a brand new Kickstarter Backer Cow and more! Read on for the list of new content in the latest update. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41182567/eee5dd0d0ec9393eca93f7beccbe1d3ceda4473f.png[/img]

[b]New upgrade category Glasses added to the game, including the following upgrades/superpowers:[/b]

[list]
[*] Bullet Upgrade - Double Shot: Fire an extra bullet.
[*] Passive Upgrade - Double Dodge: After you dodge, you can dodge again for a short period of time.
[*] Superpower Upgrade - Double Superpower: After using your superpower, you can use it again for a short period of time.
[*] Buddy Upgrade - Double Buddy Shot: Your buddy fires an extra bullet.
[*] Superpower - Double Barreled Minigun: Shoot bullets extremely quickly in two directions for a short period of time.
[/list]

[b]You will also find the following additions and changes [/b]

[list]
[*] Upgrade Barricade changed to: Enemy bullets can be shot down, triggering an explosion. Barricade's effect is not applied to new bullets for a short period of time after it triggers.
[*] Upgrade Toxic Bullet Damage changed to: When an enemy takes damage from your bullets, poisoned enemies will also take damage.
[*] Upgrade Toxic Superpower Damage changed to: When an enemy takes damage from your Superpower, poisoned enemies will also take damage.
[*] When a stunned enemy wakes up, it cannot be stunned again for a short period of time
[*] New Kickstarter backer cow added
[/list]

notes.title: Beyond the Long Night update - and 30% discount!
notes.content:
Hello Explorers,

We are excited to announce that Beyond the Long Night is included in The Quintessential Yogscast Games Sale with a 30% discount! If that news was not exciting enough we have also been hard at work with a new update. 

In this update you will find some great quality of life upgrades, including rebindable controls, an accessible font for English speaking players, and improvements to text legibility that will be especially helpful for those using the Steam Deck to play the game. A full list of changes can be found below: 

[h3][b]CHANGES:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Controls are now rebindable on both Gamepad and Keyboard & Mouse
[*] You can now change the font to an accessible one when playing the game in English
[*] You can now change the highlight colour of the "highlight enemies" option
[*] Improved the legibility of text across the board
[*] Updated the UI for Button Prompts
[*] Fixed a bug where the speed run challenge & achievement unlocked at the wrong run time
[*] Fixed a bug where you could highlight both difficulty presets in the boot up accessibility menu at the same time
[*] Replaced the localised text in the accessibility menu with professionally translated versions
[*] If a translation cannot be found for a text line, we now default to English
[*] Fixed a journal entry for Umpa not triggering if the player beat their last run.
[*] Fixed a save corruption bug if the player pressed a button in the Game Over screen multiple times
[*] Fixed an extremely rare case where the player could get locked inside of the Tutorial area
[*] You no longer lose your hat when you travel back from the Strange Dimension
[*] Fixed a bug where your max health would load incorrectly when loading back into a run
[*] You can now skip the good ending cutscene and sequence if you have triggered the good ending sequence before
[*] Fixed Tetchy and Dopey getting stuck in areas that were behind destructible walls when they follow the player
[*] Fixed a bug where the Gatekeeper of the Overworld boss would continue playing looped audio infinitely if you died during one of the sequences.
[*] Fixed a bug where Superpower Upgrades would remain applied to your bullets after Short Lived Immortality had finished.
[*] Minor optimisations
[/list]

You can check out the rest of the games in the sale [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/yogscastgames/sale/Yogscastmay2023]here[/url]

notes.title: Patch 1.00.06 - Minor bug fix patch
notes.content:
Hey folks,

Patch 1.00.06 contains a few small fixes - in particular it makes getting some of the unfolding stories easier by merging dialogue received by some characters after certain "things" happen. Hopefully this helps out some of you who are aiming for the 100% journal completion!

[b]CHANGES:[/b]
- Archie, Umpa and Pilgrim story lines can now be more easily progressed. The condition that the character must have been met once since the player last reached the end of a run has been removed, and their dialogue trees edited to reflect where the player is in the story.
- Added a small cooldown to setting combinations on blocks and cubes, to help with setting combinations when your fire rate is extremely high
- Fix for being able to start encore runs again after already selecting a different hat
- Fixed a bug where the annoying child would trap you in their shop forever

Thanks!
- Steve

notes.title: Beyond the Long Night - Difficulty and Accessibility update
notes.content:
Hello Explorers,

A lot has been going on since the launch of beyond the long Night over a week ago! We wanted to say a big thank you for all who have bought the game and all those providing feedback.

As there has been a portion of the player base who has found the game too challenging for their tastes we have been working away on an update that will not only allow for two different difficult settings but also will allow players to customise a variety of options to tailor the difficulty to their play style.

You will now be able to customise the following settings:


[list]
[*] Your Base Damage output
[*] Your base health
[*] Toggle on/off Invulnerability frames when using dodge
[*] Enemy bullet speed
[*] Enemy movement speed
[*] The Storm spread rate
[*] Your starting money
[/list]

The options can be changed at any point and can be found under the new accessibility menu. You will still be able to unlock achievements even with custom settings set.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41182567/1fb3925db0d78e36ee6590d7eb2988beb233abf3.jpg[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41182567/97f60b503746e639bc2e65e5cce692fda585504b.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41182567/5456767b24e1cd78f4fc651c1976401670f856f8.jpg[/img]


We also have implemented the following fixes

[h3]Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an unfolding story journal entry that wasn't triggering on Bobbins
[*] Added safety checks to make sure you get archie's journal entries if you satisfy the conditions
[*] Added more "connections" in the unfolding stories section of the journal for some extra hints to some solutions
[*] Added extra switches to one of the forest puzzle rooms to make sure players can't get stuck in it
[*] Moving spike blocks can now be shot to move them slightly, allowing players to move them around if they get trapped them
[*] "The Wall" map icon will now be revealed if you buy the map marker from Archie's shop
[*] Fixed a crash when the player threw the bird and transitioned between rooms before the bird had started moving to the exit
[*] Nerfed the damage given by the Bullet Damage Up upgrade
[*] Buffed the damage dealt by Spirit Dodge
[*] Decreased the price of Spirit Dodge
[*] Increased the price of Barricade
[*] Tweaked the size of button prompts and fonts in the options menu to make it more readable on Steam Deck
[*] Speculative fix for an issue where the player would get stuck when re-entering a secret room after defeating the true final boss.
[/list]

We will also be implementing more accessibility options to players to make the experience more enjoyable in the very near future, so stay tuned for future updates!

We hope these changes help you to enjoy the game in a way that suits you, and look forward to hearing your feedback on these changes.

notes.title: Thank you for playing - Plus an update on upcoming features
notes.content:
Hello brave explorers!

We would like to say a big thank you to all those who have purchased beyond the Long Night and we hope you are enjoying your time in the Dark Mountain!

We are currently addressing the common issues players have been having in the game. Two major issues we are receiving feedback on is that some players are finding it hard to see the smaller enemies, and some players are finding the game too difficult. 

As of today we have turned on the highlight enemies option by default for all new players, which makes enemies much easier to spot at a glance. If you wish to play with or without this option you can still find it in the graphics settings.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41182567/bad2908c619be6a198006aa4aded2c9693339aa0.jpg[/img]

To address the issue with the games difficulty, we are currently working on a build with selectable difficulty levels. This will be an option you will select when you first boot up the game, and will be changeable in the options menu too. We will be creating a newly balanced difficulty level that makes the journey less difficult, which we hope will make the game more enjoyable for a larger range of players. This is important to us as we want all players to be able to experience the world with a difficulty setting that offers them the correct level of challenge.

Please feel free to continue to leave your feedback on the Steam forums and the Discord channel.
[url=https://discord.gg/j3czAmmvtb]Discord[/url]

Thank you for all your feedback and Steam reviews they have been a big help.

We will keep you updated on future developments.

Patch Notes below:

[list]
[*] Highlight Enemies is now on by default. This will only affect new players who open the game for the first time. For other players, the option can be found in the Graphics options menu
[*] Keep Cursor Inside Window is now on by default. This will only affect new players who open the game for the first time. For other players, the option can be found in the Game options menu
[*] Removed several traps from a number of rooms that were in the player's movement path as they entered a room. Mostly applied to the Forest biome, although some traps in the Temple and Ice biomes have also been moved/removed
[*] Removed spike traps from places in the map where there was a small chance of the player being knocked inside a wall
[*] The journal story "Guided through a confusing world" will now also check whether the condition has been met when the game starts. This is to guard against the journal entry not unlocking properly during the conversation with The Pilgrim that triggers it.
[*] Increased the weight of large stone blocks so they can no longer be shot off pressure pads using ricochet bullets
[*] You can no longer toot during the final cutscene
[*] Removed blocks that were making passage through one of the Ice rooms impossible
[*] Tetchy and Dopey will no longer complete their escort quest if you leave for the strange dimension
[/list]

I'll be back later with a more substantial set of bug-fixes. For now, thanks for playing and hope you are enjoying yourselves!

- Steve

The time has nearly nearly upon us for our full launch! But you still have one final chance to enjoy the game before then! Simply head to the Beyond The Long Night store page and sign up to the final playtest ahead of the April 17th launch! 

Everyone who has signed up will automatically have access to the playtest. If you have not signed up and would like the chance to participate, simply go to the store page and click the "join playtest button"

notes.title: Missed the last Beyond The Long Night Playtest? - Join the bonus playtest now!
notes.content:
[b]The Beyond The Long Night bonus Playtest is now live![/b]

We are running a bonus playtest ahead of our April launch date, for everyone who wants to play some more and all those who missed the previous playtest!

Everyone who has signed up will automatically have access to the playtest. If you have not signed up and would like the chance to participate, simply go to the store page and click the "join playtest button"

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1730080/Beyond_the_Long_Night/

This update addresses bug fixes and feedback from the original playtest, as well as 2 new enemy variations for you to contend with - the fire and poison bats! Keep reading for the full patch notes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41182567/c4a730be5a7f0fa902cbcd6de7f317e329f90ae6.png[/img]

We hope you enjoy the playtest and are happy to receive your feedback on the Steam forums or Discord.

Discord link - discord.gg/j3czAmmvtb

[b]PATCH NOTES[/b]

[b]Map[/b]
- Duplicate rooms are now much rarer, the map generation system will always try to use an unused room type if it can
- Updated the colours of the pick from 3 shrines so it's clearer at a glance that the two are different and have different effects
- Added a torch to one of the forest rooms to help out in rare situations where the player's bullets are too wonky to hit the switches properly
- Tiles in front of sara's altar will now distort during the storm

[b]Enemies & Hazards[/b]
- New enemy variations added - small poison bats and large fire bats
- Removed explosion damage on player from bomb bees
- Slowed down the projectiles that fire out from Bomb Bees
- Fixed issue where the Imp enemy could teleport to an unreachable part of the map in one of the temple rooms.
- Fixed a bug where lasers would trigger switches every frame they hit them

Upgrades, Superpowers & Throwable Items
- Spirit bullets now applies to lasers as well as walls and enemies
- Barricade (shield bullet upgrade) now works on the bullets that fly out of toxic enemies on death
- Spirit bullets now takes priority over bouncing bullets
- After you use a throwable item (torch, bomb, etc), the next time you toggle your held item you will automatically go back to your main bullet weapon
- You can no longer toggle your held item while shooting or using your superpower
- Decreased the mouse scroll wheel sensitivity when toggling your held items
- Fixed spirit protectors destroying on objects that don't deal damage
- Fixed a bug where the thrown bird would get stuck in certain rooms and not be able to escape
[13:29]
UI
- Allow players to quickly start a new run from the end screen and skip the animations
- Fixed bug where the pop up UI would flicker on and off without showing the popup text after dialogue
- Fixed pick from 3 menu occasionally updating to show a higher level than your current upgrade level if you moused over the button during the selection animation
- Reduced the range of the brightness setting in the options menu to avoid players getting a pitch black screen

[b]Characters[/b]
- Fixed a bug where the first item in Eebi's shop after finding and engraving all of the moo-tivational quotes wouldn't be free
- Cows that spawn in the wild will always be one you haven't discovered before now (unless you have discovered all of them, when it will be random)
- Fixed a bug where the player was able to move and open menus during the cow petting animation
- Fixed the cow shaun having the wrong hat in their dialogue box

[b]Audio[/b]
- Fixed the mole sleeping sound getting stuck on after the mole was destroyed
- Fixed the wrong biome music playing in the first room of a new biome
- Fixed the wrong layer of the temple combat music intro being ducked when the storm is nearby
- New emotes for the Pilgrim
- Tweaks to annoying child's loud shout emote
- New sound when shields recharge
- Mix tweaks

- Added the Forbidden Temple
- Added new NPC - The Pilgrim
- Superpower: Short-lived Immortality has changed to - "Become immune for a short period of time. While this effect is active, your bullets are additionally affected by your Superpower upgrades."
- Added new unfolding stories to the Journal

The storm system has been tweaked to try to reduce situations where you get completely cut off with nowhere to go. The following changes have been made:
- The storm will no longer spread into a room containing Bobbins unless the player has discovered that room.
- The storm will no longer spread more that one room's height above the player
- If the storm is between 3 and 8 rooms away, it will only spread to rooms in the player's direction.
- Slightly increased the maximum spread rate of the storm to balance out these changes.

[b]Polish and bug fixes:[/b]
- Gave every entry in the Unfolding Stories section of the journal a unique icon
- Updated and polished upgrade descriptions & titles
- Fixed a bug where save data would get corrupted
- Balance pass on the cost of items in the shop
- Updated the font on Tutorial boards
- Updated the appearance of button prompts
- Updated the colour of the highlight enemies mode to be more friendly on the eyes for people with colour blindness
- Fixed bug where the blurred background in menu screens would show an old room the player had been in
- Shiny stones will now automatically travel to the player if there are no enemies in the room when they spawn
- Fixed some tiles being on the wrong layer in the Temple
- Buffed the health of Imps
- Bees now slow down when they inflate
- Added singing voices for the dreamy text in the start of run sequence
- Increased the volume of combat music
- Spelling error fixes

notes.title: Beyond The Long Night Demo now live as part of Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
[h1][b]The Beyond The Long Night demo is now playable as part of Steam Next Fest! [/b][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41182567/d5ed8d2f67b073187a44f6f1fcf6550d6d2c1719.jpg[/img]

We're thrilled to get this out there - a brand new demo with more content, including 16 new upgrades, four new super powers, shrines that allow you to pick between three different upgrades and much, much more! 

But that is not all! We have also hidden an item within the Next Fest demo which you will be able to find by paying close attention to the in game journal  - and the first five people to take a screenshot upon obtaining it and putting it in the "Hidden-Item-Challenge" channel in the Beyond the Long Night Discord will win a copy of the game. We'll also be giving away random copies beyond the initial five, so even if you're late to the demo it's still well worth taking part. 

discord.gg/j3czAmmvtb

We will also have a live broadcast on Tuesday the 7th at 14:00(GMT) 06:00 (PST) so be sure to check the Steam page to watch the live stream!

We really hope you can check out the demo and the live stream over Next Fest and will have more exciting news to come very soon. 

Detailed patch notes as follows


[b]Patch Notes[/b]:
- [b]4 new upgrade categories added, including 16 new Upgrades and 4 new Superpowers[/b]
-- [b]Spooky Little Cloud[/b]: Upgrades themed around spooks!
-- [b]Holy Goblet[/b]: Upgrades themed around immunity
-- [b]Fire Seeds[/b]: Upgrades themed around fire
-- [b]Doppelganger[/b]: Upgrades themed around doubles
- Added shrines that offer you a choice of three different upgrades
- Added shrines that allow you to improve one of your existing upgrades
- Added new throwing item Bombs - "Can be detonated remotely and will explode on contact with enemies." Found in treasure chests and some shops.
- New Kickstarter motivational cows to discover
- Highlight enemies mode added to the video settings
- Lots of new audio!
- The demo is now available on Mac

[b]Upgrades/Superpower changes[/b]:
- Increased the period of immunity after using the pinball superpower, giving the player longer to escape danger if they end up in a bad spot
- Laser Focus (clock Superpower) changed to: "Aim and shoot a laser beam that does more damage if multiple enemies are hit at once. Time is slowed while aiming."
- Passive and superpower shields changed to: "Generate a shield that wears off after a short period of time and breaks upon taking damage. Recharging your superpower will also extend the life of the shield." The base time the shield is active has been drastically reduced
- Self Destruct changed to: "Blow up one of your balloons, triggering a large, highly damaging explosion. If your health is above 50%, take one damage. If your health is below 50%, deal twice as much damage to enemies."
- Increased knockback (wind superpower upgrade) changed to: "Enemy knockback caused by superpowers is increased. Superpowers do slightly more damage."

[b]Polish/Bugs[/b]:
- Updated Unity Engine
- Updated Wwise (audio engine)
- Fixed bug where the bird would fly sideways if thrown downwards
- Fixed a bug where you could get into an infinite conversation with two cow statues
- You can now open the Current Build menu from any Pick from three menu
- Greatly reduced the loading times when starting a completely fresh run
- Increased the grace period before certain enemies start attacking the player
- Superpower charge HUD tweaked
- Fixed ricocheting bullets sometimes travelling inside the map
- Fixed fireworks sometimes travelling inside the map
- Fixed missing journal entry for selecting the shield stone at a monument
- Slowed down the speed of dart trap projectiles
- Reduced the number of dart traps in some rooms where they were excessive
- You now have to travel further into a biome before the max number of enemies in a room is reached
- Your player level and your progress last run has more of an impact on the initial difficulty of the next run
- Killing enemies and collecting health items makes the difficulty ramp up slightly faster
- Superpowers are offered much less, and upgrades are favored much more. 
- Fixed an issue where doors were opening and immediately closing when you entered a room
- Weighted blocks now trigger dart traps
- Thorns now shimmer like spikes do
- Undiscovered map icons (i.e. question marks) now display in the centre of a room until the room is discovered
- Added a pop-up when you collect a moo-tivational quote from a cow
- Fixed cow hats not properly aligning with the cow's head in the dialogue box
- Dialogue tweaks and new additions
- Added an animation for the player waking up
- Added an animation for gaining a balloon
- Optimisations focused on reducing spikes in performance when the player wakes up, between room transitions and when auto saving. Ongoing process.
- Bumped up biome ambiences in volume when there is no music playing
- Fixed the delete save buttons being tricksy to focus the mouse on
- Fixed encore run forgetting your last build if you exited the game between the runs

notes.title: Demo 1.12.00 is out NOW! And it's a biggie!
notes.content:
Welcome explorers!

To celebrate Dreamhack Beyond's Indie Showcase, we've just launched a huge update to the free demo of Beyond the Long Night. There's a ton of new content to discover - new upgrades to play with, new enemies to contend with, a new game mode that turns up the chaos, and new entries in the journal to fill out.

[h1]Patch Notes:[/h1]

[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*] New game mode Party Hat - Everything gets quicker!
[*] New game mode select screen. Every game mode has a unique hat.
[*] 8 new Upgrades, 2 new Superpowers. The Berseker and Bomb categories, themed around high damage at low health, and explosions.
[*] 2 new enemies - The Imp and the paradise bird.
[*] 2 new bee enemy variations - Poison bees and Bomb bees.
[*] Fire enemies now shoot 3x as many projectiles at once, and explode into flames on death.
[*] Poison enemies are now much faster, shoot much more often, and release poisonous projectiles on death that slow you down. The slow down effect from poisonous enemies has been strengthened.
[*] New unfolding stories with Bobbins, the Annoying Child, Eebi and Umpa.
[*] The first batch of Kickstarter Complimentary Cows are discoverable in game.
[*] Almost double the room variation.
[*] Map generation has been tweaked to create a more maze-like map layout.
[*] Added rubber banding to the storm spreading speed.
[*] Enabled Steam Cloud Saves
[*] New item [REDACTED] to help locate [REDACTED] and solve [REDACTED]
[/list]

[b]Polish and bug fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Unity engine updated.
[*] New font and updated several parts of the UI
[*] Tons of new sounds.
[*] Dart traps now emit a small light shaft from their mouths when they’re ready to shoot.
[*] Dodge Parry now parries enemy bullets from further away, making it easier to use the effect.
[*] Dialogue tweaks across several characters.
[*] Removed the New Adventure option from the main menu after the first run, leaving just Continue and New Run. You can now delete your save data in the options menu (main menu only) if you’d like to reset your save.
[*] Tweaks to existing rooms.
[*] Updated the trailer at the end of a run to the Kickstarter launch trailer.
[*] Umpa is more likely to land on the ground rather than standing in mid air over an open bottom exit
[*] Added a map icon for Pickles
[*] Reduced the gaps between ambient music tracks
[*] Lots more small fixes & tweaks.
[/list]

Finally, due to big changes with the journal, I unfortunately had to reset everybody's journal save data for this update. This will mean starting again unfortunately - I know this is frustrating and I'm really sorry for any inconvenience caused.

Happy exploring!
Steve

notes.title: Going Rogue! New demo update + developer live stream.
notes.content:
Hi folks, Steve from Noisy Head here.

We're bringing the Beyond the Long Night demo back to Steam for Going Rogue fest (May 2nd - 9th)! The game has been completely rebalanced for faster, more exciting combat, more satisfying visual effects and some more combat QOL fixes. There's never been a better time to check the demo out!

We'll also be live streaming the new demo directly on our Steam page from 12PM PT (8PM BST) on Monday May 2nd. It's the perfect time to come hang out with us and ask any questions you may have. I'll be chatting about how the game is designed, what our thought processes are when we create new rooms, how we approach things like music and sound design, as well as any other interesting bits and bobs we find along the way. Should be really fun, so do pop down and say hello!

Have fun with the new changes!

[b]Patch Notes[/b]

[b]New Features[/b]
- Player main weapon has been rebalanced to be much faster paced. Enemies have been rebalanced to reflect this change, both through health and speed. Superpowers now take slightly more hits to fully charge.
- New player animation system - animations are now smoother and more responsive.
- Many visual improvements on projectiles, explosions, enemy damage and death.
- Monument art updated, along with a new sequence added when selecting a stone.
- Enemy projectiles are now standardised and colour coded (based on any additional effects) across all enemies. Bee and Dart Trap projectiles are now much more noticable.
- The following Upgrades have been tweaked:
- “Reflective Superpowers” and “Dodge Parry” - parried projectiles will now fire straight at the enemy target, making them much more likely to hit!
- “Dodge Damage” now uses a small amount of auto aim to pick an enemy target when they are close. The chosen enemy target is shown via a small additional crosshair.
- Dodge Damage now begins to charge immediately, and moves the player's dodge to when they release the dodge button.
- Superdodge no longer auto triggers dodge attack when Superdodge is level 2 or above.
- Superdodge will still trigger immediately if dodge attack is also upgraded.
- “Turbulence” now increases the player fire rate by a lot! The “wonky bullet” effect ramps up much slower on successive upgrades.
- The cows now moo!

[b]Bugs/Polish[/b]
- Crosshair now animates when the player shoots.
- Dart Traps have been subtly lightened to make them more noticeable.
- Spikes now animate with a “sheen” effect.
- Fixed an idle animation where the player would lose their hat for a couple of frames.
- Fixed a small bit of grass that was the wrong tile in one of the forest rooms.
- Removed some spikes in one of the Dart Trap puzzle rooms, creating an upper alternative path.
- Added sounds for parrying bullets.
- In game clock now pauses if the player is in a menu that pauses the game.
- Rendering and UI optimisations.
- Fixed bug where Journal entries wouldn't save if the player exited to desktop in the end game screen
- Increased time player input is blocked when entering the shop (to avoid accidentally buying an item if spamming skip through a conversation)
- Fixed player bullets still spawning if the player performed an action that cancelled their shot (such as dodging or switching to a torch)
- Added a very subtle camera shake when the player shoots their primary weapon
- Swapped some lanterns that were on the floor with wooden candle holders
- Fixed bug where camera wouldn't zoom out smoothly after a conversation
- Tweaked camera panning and zooming to make it smoother
- Fixed bug where vignette effect would snap to the maximum value when zooming out of a conversation early
- Camera will now always stay in the range of the room when zooming in
- Tweaks to the monument stone item spawn sequence
- Conversations with characters are disabled for a short period of time after finishing a conversation (to avoid the player entering a new conversation immediately if spamming skip through the dialogue)
- When a Superpower's charge is cancelled (e.g. when taking damage), don't immediately trigger the Superpower. Instead we reset the charge back to full.
- Shiny stones now auto travel to the player if they spawn in a room with them after a save.
- Fixed shield audio hanging over into the main menu if the player left the game with a shield active
- Doubled the invincibility timer after taking a hit
- Fixed aim reticule moving across the screen after dialogue
- In "Lap of Honour", make sure to spawn a buddy if the player had one last run
- Visual tweaks to player bullets
- Visual tweaks to slow down bullets
